notes.title: May 2023 Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I know I haven't done an update on this game for a little while, and that's mainly because I've been working on another smaller game. I am almost done with it though, and I'm hoping by the end of June I can release it and finally get back into production on "Spectre's Library". I'm still excited to get it done, and I think working on my other project has definitely helped me form a more solid base and story for this game as well.

But that's not the main reason I'm making this update post. I'm actually making this post because I went back into the demo and fixed a few bugs that I noticed were there. There wasn't anything major, but I figured I shouldn't leave it in an unfixed state. There were a few main things I fixed, including making one of the puzzles' hints more understandable, and re-exporting the demo to include the RTP assets so the game can function properly. (I had to do this with the Steam version of the demo when I initially released it, but I didn't think to go back and do this with the GameJolt/Itch.io versions. Oops.) 

As well as fix these bugs, I also renamed the project to "Spectre's Library (DEMO)". I decided that this demo will be the only demo for the game, and there won't be one for the other chapters. This would save a bunch of time, as well as leave the future chapters more of a surprise to players, which I think I like better.

Anyway, I'll wrap this up. I'm very excited for everyone to see the full chapter, and the game as a whole. I know I haven't worked on it in a long time, and that's okay. I was never pressuring myself to get this or any of my current/future projects done in a fast timeframe. I've learned that if I try to pressure myself into getting my games done, the final product suffers a lot because of it, and I won't be satisfied with how it came out. I just hope that you guys can be patient for me to get this done. It will be done, I promise! It just takes time.

If you'd like to check out the demo, you can here:
https://matt-mcgreevy.itch.io/spectres-library-chapter-i-demo
https://gamejolt.com/games/spectreslibrarych1demo/770279

I also stream every week! If you'd like to see my shenanigans, feel free to check me out below:
https://www.youtube.com/@matt_mcgreevy

I hope everyone is doing well, and I hope everyone has a great day today!
I'll see YOU... next time!
-Matt

notes.title: January 2023 Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This month has been pretty busy for me, mainly with personal stuff and work. I had a stretch of like a week or two where I was unmotivated, but I'm feeling better now. It hasn't been super eventful in terms of the game, but that doesn't mean I haven't been working on it! What have I been up to, you ask? Let me tell you!

First, I tackled the beginning of the game, which takes place before where the demo starts. I already had an image of how I wanted the introduction to go, so it didn't take super long to do. It went through a couple iterations, but I settled with a version that I liked. It might go through some changes, but they'll likely be small.

Next, I went through all of what I had and implemented the voice acting system. I did have my siblings record some voice clips for the first part of the chapter, but I haven't gone through them and edited them yet. I don't plan on editing them yet, but I did want to have the system ready so I can just put in the final recordings without having to worry about too much. It wasn't terribly difficult to implement, but it was a little tedious.

At this point, I started to feel unmotivated to work on the game. I felt this way for about a week/week and a half. As the motivation and inspiration slowly made it's way back, I started working on maps/level design for Rose's story. I had already started this process before I released the demo; I had made the house where the story starts/takes place.
Then, most recently, I drafted/made the transition to the story, and the story's introduction. It was a lot of audio work, surprisingly, and I pretty much made it on the fly without any plan. This isn't the first time this has happened, sometimes I'll just come up with an idea and it'll come out good. This is one of those times; the intro to the story came out very good. I'll probably make some adjustments later, but for now I'm satisfied.

Anyway, I'm gonna wrap this up. I'm very excited for everyone to see this chapter, and the game as a whole. I'll keep working on it in the background, hopefully next month I'll have a more eventful description of everything that happened.

If you'd like to check out the demo, you can here:
https://matt-mcgreevy.itch.io/spectres-library-chapter-i-demo
https://gamejolt.com/games/spectreslibrarych1demo/770279

I also stream a video game every week, and I occasionally talk about Spectre's Library! If you'd like to see my streaming shenanigans, feel free to below:
https://www.youtube.com/@matt_mcgreevy

I hope everyone is doing well, and I hope everyone has a great day today!
I'll see you all next month!
-Matt
